scope: Read-only CSV-level numerical and bookkeeping QA. No raw bag reread, detector/tracker invocation, parameter change, label modification, threshold selection or new method experiment.
verification_boundary: PASS verifies artifact arithmetic/joins, not UAV point identity, calibrated GNSS truth, target absence, physical field semantics, independent evaluation or scientific generalization.

methods.execution: Read-only standard-library CSV parsing and independent NumPy calculations via PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 fmcw/bin/python. Frozen extraction/statistics helpers were not called to reproduce their outputs.
methods.E15_join: ANCHOR_3m versus E15 frame_metrics.csv target_radius_m=3.0, exact sequence_id/frame_index join; 80 rows and 24 comparable fields per row. Float comparison absolute tolerance 1e-9; all finite errors actually zero; paired undefined values remain undefined.
methods.support_frequencies: Reconstruct every recorded grouping from target-region CSV rows; independently check total rows, 0/1/2/>2 numerators and empirical frame proportions.
methods.matched_effects: Reconstruct every sequence/nominal-range/range-bin/eta-bin group with conditioning recipe separate. Match sequence/frame/recipe/radius; within each eligible frame average fixed-direction 1(U>C)+0.5*tie over finite controls, then average frames equally. Independently reproduce Cliff delta, paired target-minus-control-median effect, average-IQR scaling and all eligibility counts. No sign flipping, p-values, confidence intervals or threshold selection.
methods.run_checks: Verify every ZERO_REGION_RUN contains only supported zero-count target-region rows in one GNSS segment; recorded frame count and last-minus-first sample span are correct. Verify uncensored brackets are adjacent nonzero observations at recorded times. All supported zero rows are covered exactly once. SAVED_LOCALIZATION_AVAILABILITY has no fabricated zero-return runs. Observation gaps are distinct from zero-return evidence.

anchor1m_nonempty_feature_auc_status: UNKNOWN: no eligible nonempty control frame for intensity, Doppler, NN or geometry comparisons.
scientific_qualifications: ANCHOR counts condition on 80 previously observed LiDAR-derived silver anchors. Their zero count frequency is selection-conditioned, not a sensor missed-detection rate.
ANCHOR_1m raw-count AUC=1 compares selected return-bearing regions against 320 entirely empty proxy regions; it does not demonstrate UAV-versus-return-bearing-clutter recognition.
ANCHOR_3m has only 7 nonempty controls out of 318. High intensity AUCs rest on 6 near-range frames or one mid-range frame; far-range feature comparisons are undefined, not perfect separation.
AUC orientation is fixed higher-UAV. High absolute Doppler residual AUC means larger target-conditioned residual, not superior Doppler consistency; no orientation was selected after inspection.

Residuals compare measured fields against uncertain piecewise GNSS chord range-rate, not exact instantaneous target velocity. The control residual is a hypothetical UAV-motion-template residual, not control-object velocity ground truth.
Only cross-dominant, eta<0.5 nominal states are available; range, sequence, speed, interpolation segment and time are confounded. The study cannot establish high-radial or hover generalization.
Thirty-one coarse 1m single-cell observations include only one raw singleton. Coarse shape collapse is a representation artifact, not zero UAV body size or lack of sensor returns.
Scenario-union support/shape can reflect spread of uncertain possible locations, not UAV geometry. Fixed-sphere diameter bounds are imposed by region construction.
Empty controls may reflect empty air, scan/FOV coverage or occlusion; they are local clutter proxies, never verified negatives.
No feature weighting, classifier threshold, operational precision, new detector/tracker or independent benchmark conclusion follows from this QA.
